_source: Original Project Largo palette inspired by forest greens, cream, teal and pink shells.
_notes: Original Largo palette, 2026-10-19. Wallpaper-inspired forest shadows, sage foliage, warm cream, weathered teal and pink shells; adjusted for readable UI contrast. Dark role-contract v1: primary=focus/actions/strong selection, secondary/tertiary=supporting accents, surface/onSurface=body/icons, surfaceVariant=panels, hover/onHover=hover. Error/ANSI red, success/ANSI green and warning/ANSI yellow share status roles. No light variant.
